step2_determination: Determined separately at each of the six decision points the contract requires. (a) REQUIRED WITH ERAS SUBMISSION: No. The program lists a Step 2 transcript among ERAS application components but sets no submission-time deadline for it, and the operative sentence names a later deadline. (b) REQUIRED BEFORE INITIAL REVIEW: Ambiguous on the program's own text and resolved against a pre-review requirement. The How to Apply preamble reads 'You must complete all components of the ERAS Application for your application to be considered complete and to be reviewed by the Selection Committee. Our application requirements are the same as the standard ERAS application:' followed by a bullet list that includes the Step 2 transcript. Read in isolation that could imply Step 2 is needed before review. But the very next bullet sets the actual deadline at rank-list submission AND its parenthetical explicitly contemplates an applicant who was 'invited for an interview' while having no Step 2 score uploaded — which is impossible if Step 2 were a precondition of review. The specific, later, operative rule therefore governs, and the ambiguity is recorded rather than erased. (c) REQUIRED BEFORE INTERVIEW INVITATION: No, and this is positively established rather than merely unstated. The parenthetical '(assuming you were invited for an interview)' presupposes interview invitations issued to applicants without an uploaded Step 2 score. (d) REQUIRED BEFORE RANKING: Yes, unambiguously, with a stated consequence. (e) REQUIRED BEFORE START DATE ONLY: No — the deadline is materially earlier than the start date. (f) NO CLEAR PUBLISHED TIMING or CONFLICTING: Not applicable; the timing is explicit. A separate note on FREIDA: the 2026-06-15 survey sets field_usmle_step_2_required = false and field_usmle
